name: read_total_balance
description: Open Accounts Overview and read the Total row into an output named total_balance

approved_plan.goal: Open Accounts Overview and read the Total row into an output named total_balance

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using the supplied username and password

steps.intent: Read the Total row from the Accounts Overview table
steps.action: Locate the Total row at the bottom of the accounts table and capture its balance value into the output total_balance

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

approved_plan.success_signal: The Accounts Overview page is displayed with a Total row visible at the bottom of the accounts table

hardening_rejected: s02_click: detector 'accounts_overview_link_missing' rejected: 'Accounts Overview' is visible on the page the run just succeeded on, so it can never distinguish that outcome from a genuine one

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

outputs.name: total_balance
outputs.description: Read from the page during discovery; a currency amount, returned as a number

business_outcomes.description: The supplied username/password were rejected by ParaBank; the user cannot be authenticated.
Authentication succeeded but the customer has no accounts, so the accounts table contains no data rows and no Total row to read.

when.value: The username and password could not be verified.

then.message: ParaBank rejected the supplied credentials. Verify username and password and retry.

candidates.rationale: accessible role and name, most stable across restyling

steps.description: Total balance value from the Total row at the bottom of the accounts table

then.message: The accounts table returned no rows; there is no Total balance to extract for this customer.
The accounts table reported an error while loading. The back-office service may be unavailable; check application logs.

on_exhausted.message: The Total row was not present in the accounts table. The customer may have no accounts associated with this login.

target.description: Total balance value from the Total row at the bottom of the accounts table

candidates.rationale: row anchored by first cell text, for id-less legacy tables

success.description: Page state proving success: The heading "Accounts Overview" is rendered as the page/section title every time the accounts table is successfully loaded, regardless of the actual balance figures shown. It is stable page state, not a data value.
